title: Eneo karibu na bweni langu Clark lilikuwa na amani sana, kwa hiyo nilitembea mara nyingi
label: Clark yenye amani

text.I lived in an area called Clark in the P: Niliishi katika eneo linaloitwa Clark nchini Ufilipino.
text.Even from my point of view as a Japanese: Hata kwa mtazamo wangu kama Mjapani, Clark ni salama kama Japani.
text.Also, like California in America, it was: Kama California nchini Marekani, palikuwa tulivu na penye amani sana.
Palikuwa mahali pazuri na penye amani.
text.Because it was that kind of place, I oft: Kwa kuwa palikuwa mahali pa namna hiyo, mara nyingi nilitembea.
text.▶️ The area around my dorm in Clark: ▶️ Eneo karibu na bweni langu Clark
text.The owner of my language school often dr: Mmiliki wa shule yangu ya lugha mara nyingi alikuwa akinipeleka Koreatown huko Angeles kwa gari
text.I rented a whole jeepney and got a ride: Nilikodisha jeepney nzima na nikapata usafiri wa kwenda nyumbani
